transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to avoid heavy lifting and strenuous work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thanks for letting me know. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops or treatment before your operation for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you were told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for clarifying. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, you can wear sunglasses outside. But if it is severe, or you have significant pain, especially with a red and painful eye, that is not normal and may need to be checked further. Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, just one more. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you so much for the information.

verdict.label: fail
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` in turn 7 by stating, "Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses." However, the agent was interrupted and did not convey `escalation_criteria` or `mild_case_advice`.
